videos.title: GTA 6's First Patch Fixes Your Broken Story Missions 🛠️ #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Rockstar's first GTA 6 post-launch update, 01.002.002 (Nov 23, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S), fixes autosaves, story phone calls that never triggered, stuck weather and a Wanted Level you couldn't lose. No 60 FPS mode and no change to money glitches.

Sources: Rockstar Games patch notes, Push Square, PC Gamer, VICE, ComicBook

videos.title: GTA 6 Just Broke PlayStation's Biggest Record 🎮 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Sony says GTA 6 is the biggest launch in PlayStation history: 39M+ unique PS5 players, 683 million hours played from Nov 19 to Nov 22, a new concurrent-player record, and the first game played on 70% of new PS5s. Those are players, not copies sold.

Sources: PlayStation Blog, Push Square, TweakTown, Inven Global

videos.title: Don't Panic About This GTA 6 Missable Trophy 🏆 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Trophy hunters feared the Positive Mental Attitude trophy is missable because Lucia's balcony meditation only appears in Chapter 1. Newer testing says the trophy unlocks without it, but guides disagree and Rockstar hasn't confirmed, so do it anyway.
